I know this might sound crazy but I am desperate for land and I have goals!
So please dont call me crazy or inconsiderate of others near me.
(This is an expansion rp thing ) 
With the reign of xordrsia coming to an end much can be done like expand further into gladês and letent as well as claiming the land that was lost at the end of mataís empire!
Yet again xordisia and the land south of that were once part of the original Akhratian empire and mataís empire meaning that there are many ethnic Akhratian there additionally Xordisia was a cruel dictatorship that treated its citizens without kindness and we are hoping to undo centuries of mistreatment under the people who should care for you.
And so my second argument is that from the fall of mataís empire we have lacked resources such as gold and coal and while we dont need coal gold still has many uses in Akhratia
Additionally this land has been unstable ever since mataís empire collapsed so I ask of you to please except my request as this expansion would also help me against versia as tensions rise. Ever since the fall of mataís empire versia has hated Akhratia and now with us reclaiming our rightful lands all hell could break loose. Xordisia and the territory under it are unique as they provide room for me to expand further into the future as well as gain access to important trade routes with the western elseyr nations.
So more history:
Xordisia and the southern territory were parts of Akhratia way before mataís empire fell with glade and letent having its land in what was once Xordisia.
And now with the government gone these people need a stable nation with kind leaders and people devoted to helping those in need and since Akhratian is a wildly spoken language in Xordisia they will have no trouble with adapting.
On another note I know this expansion seems feather large but isnt that what the whole expansion thing is about? I understand if I do t get much or any of the territory as many others probably want it as well but I implore you to let me expand as I am a nation. That is stable and prepared to handle more people with a painful past.
All the best Akhratia.
P.s 
I know this is insane but I dont need all the land I just want to have more geographic influence on north and western elseyr

How does your nation address environmental sustainability in its industrial sector?

[i]This is an automated message.[/i]

[quote=shahzada;59271218][b]Question of the Day #120:[/b]

How does your nation address environmental sustainability in its industrial sector?

[i]This is an automated message.[/i][/quote]

We have a lot of nuclear reactors. It's basically the best form of energy with a high money price. It's emissions are steam, and you dont need to destroy 18563(^7) Miles of land to power one small town. You can have trees surrounding it without any downsides. Just make sure to trim them. The employees of the reactors are treated like protectors, and get extra benefits. They (after being employed) are subjected to propaganda to ensure healthy, risk-free energy.
